63845: Kyouko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. Her talent is unknown. Kyouko is a mysterious, stoic, and independent person who deliberately masks her feelings so that others won't be able to read her.
63849: Sayaka is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Idol (超高校級のアイドル), or the Ultimate Pop Sensation in the English localization. She is the lead singer of an incredibly popular idol group.
63851: Makoto is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life.
65523: Junko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant in the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Gyaru, or Ultimate Fashionista in the English localization. Junko is talkative, charismatic, and can be hotheaded at times.
65529: Touko is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Literary Girl, or the Ultimate Writing Prodigy in the English localization.
65531: Aoi is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. She is the Super High School Level Swimmer (超高校級のスイマー), or Ultimate Swimming Pro in the English localization. Always energetic and friendly, Asahina is also a bit airheaded.
65533: Yasuhiro is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Fortune Teller, or Ultimate Clairvoyant in the English localization. Yasuhiro is cheery, laid-back, and a bit of a conspiracy theorist.
65541: Byakuya is a student in Hope's Peak Academy's Class 78th, and a participant of the Killing School Life. He is the Super High School Level Heir, or the Ultimate Affluent Progeny in the English localization.
73205: A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. Chiaki normally has a quiet and sleepy disposition, but she becomes a lot more lively when discussing games and concentrates hard when playing.
73213: A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip.
73227: Nagito is a student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. On the surface, Nagito is friendly and easygoing. He genuinely cares for his classmates and holds a lot of respect for ideals like love, friendship, and teamwork.
73235: A stuffed robotic bear and the self-proclaimed Headmaster of Hope's Peak Academy who instigates the various killing games in the Danganronpa series. Monokuma is often described as easygoing and cheerful at first glance, but with a very sinister undertone..
89997: The Former Director of Hope's Peak, being succeeded by Jin Kirigiri. In Future Arc, he is the founder and chairman of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 1 Director.
89998: During her time in Class 76th at Hope's Peak Academy. In Future Arc, she is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 8 Director. Her responsibility as the director is assistance in procuring stable food sources.
89999: During his time in Class 74th at Hope's Peak Academy. In Future Arc, he is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 6 Director.
90000: Ryota is a very timid, insecure, and rather asocial person. He holds anime in very high regard and is extremely passionate about it, considering it his savior during his harsh childhood. His life goal is to give others a similar sense of hope through his anime.
90001: During his time at Hope's Peak Academy, he was the original homeroom teacher of Class 77-B, being succeeded by Chisa Yukizome, and a scout for talented students. He is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 3 Director.
90003: She was later Class 77-B's homeroom teacher, and then the Future Foundation's Branch 5 Office Director responsible for the inquiry and secret intelligence regarding Despair. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.
90005: A former student of Class 76th at Hope's Peak Academy. She is a member of the Future Foundation as the Branch Office 4 Director, responsible for the research and development of new medical techniques.
90006: A former student of Class 76th at Hope's Peak Academy. He is a member of the Future Foundation as the Branch Office 9 Director, responsible for the preparation, development, and management of armaments/weapons.
90007: Hajime seems cynical at first glance, but it would be better to describe him as a realist. He is quite skeptical and tends to worry more than the other students, but his worries are usually understandable.
90010: Fuyuhiko is initially incredibly stand-offish and rude to the other students. When he does interact with them, his attitude is combative and irritable. He was born as the heir of Kuzuryu Clan, but he thinks that his younger sister, Natsumi, deserves the title instead.
90011: Nekomaru is a vigorous, boisterous, openhearted student who is passionate about supporting athletes. He is very optimistic and his willpower is immeasurable, but he isn't very smart and is bad at lying. He enjoys fighting and often trains with Akane Owari.
90012: Teruteru says he wishes to be known under the title of the Ultimate Chef.
90013: Peko initially appears to be rather serious and intimidating, expressing little emotion. However, she isn't unsociable and doesn't mean to act cold. For a long time she didn't smile because she thought it was unnecessary, and she says she eventually forgot how to.
90015: Sonia is princess of the Kingdom of Novoselic, a place with a very unique culture and traditions.
90016: Akane is a tall, young woman with an athletic, curvaceous physique. Akane has a fiery personality and she loves fighting, as long as there is no other weapons besides the person's own fists and body, which lets her get along very well with Nekomaru Nidai.
90017: She appears as an innocent girl, but she can be extremely rude. She calls Togami "Mr. Porkfeet" and Tsumiki "Dirty Bitch."
90019: A student of Hope's Peak Academy's Class 77-B, and a participant of the Killing School Trip. Kazuichi is a highly emotional character, though he tries to play it smooth and acts carefree at first. He is a very jumpy person, easily scared and often screaming in fear.
90020: Mahiru is optimistic, sensible, and unafraid to speak her mind. She's a reliable person who is prone to taking care of people, but won't hesitate to scold them either. Hajime has likened being scolded by her to being yelled at by his mom.
90248: The true leader of the Warriors of Hope and the head of the "Mage" class. Her title when she attended Hope's Peak Elementary was Li'l Ultimate Homeroom (超小学生級の学活の時間 lit. Super Elementary School Level Homeroom Period).
120463: The vice leader of the Warriors of Hope and the head of the "Sage" class. His title when he attended Hope's Peak Elementary was Li'l Ultimate Social Studies. Nagisa is the most serious member of the Warriors. He is calm, intelligent and educated, yet also the most child-like.
120464: One of the five members of the Warriors of Hope and the head of the "Fighter" class. Her title when she attended Hope's Peak Elementary was Li'l Ultimate Drama (超小学生級の学芸会の時間 lit. Super Elementary School Level Arts Festival Period).
131632: The headmaster of Hope's Peak Academy.
131696: One of the five members of the Warriors of Hope and the head of the "Priest" class. His title when he attended Hope's Peak Elementary was Li'l Ultimate Art (超小学生級の図工の時間 lit. Super Elementary School Level Drawing Period).
131698: The "leader" of the Warriors of Hope and the head of the "Hero" class. His title when he attended Hope's Peak Elementary was Li'l Ultimate P.E. (超小学生級の体育の時間 lit. Super Elementary School Level P.E. Period).
131870: Komaru begins as a somewhat hypersensitive and cowardly person who often wavers between hope and despair. She doesn't want to have strong hope, because she believes it will be lost eventually, leading to worse despair.
159365: The Ultimate Imposter's real appearance is that of a person with long, black hair and green eyes with a heavy build. Their age and gender is unknown, but they are able to give off a largely male impression while disguised as Byakuya and even mimic his voice perfectly.
165525: During her time at Hope's Peak Academy, her title was the Ultimate Therapist, where she also helped develop the Neo World Program. She is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 7 Director.
